title: afk
description: Per-channel/user AFK status. One document per (channel, user) pair.

userid.description: Sender Twitch user id (legacy field, present on some older docs)

is_afk.description: True while the user is currently AFK in this channel

afk.description: Legacy placeholder field, always null on new docs

afk_message.description: Optional message left when going AFK (truncated to 400 chars)

afk_since.description: Unix seconds when the user went AFK

afk_return.description: Unix seconds when the user came back from AFK

afk_type.description: Alias used to go AFK (afk, ler, dormir, gym, ...)

rafk_counter.description: Number of consecutive !rafk uses since last return
